how i learned to trade $SPY 0DTE with zero experience.

1. googled "how do SPY options work" and went down a rabbit hole for a week.

2. spent 1 month just watching SPY every morning. no trades. learned how price reacts at whole dollar levels.

3. picked one setup:
first touch at a key level.
RSI confirming above 70 or below 30.
that's it.

4. started with 1 contract. $100 deployed. real money, real fills, real emotion. documented every single trade.

5. blew a few setups, broke my own rules, lost money i didn't need to lose.

6. kept showing up at 6:30am anyway.

7. the system started clicking.

now i trade before work every morning, from my phone, and document everything publicly on X — wins and losses.

if i had to start over, i'd do every step exactly the same.

except step 5.

10 years of options trading. 4 strategies.

Here's what each one did to my account:

#1. 0DTE / weeklies

Spent months building my account, then blew it all in a single afternoon chasing lottery tickets. 

Six figures burned. 

#2. Covered calls

Waited 4 months for my Tesla LEAPs to move. 

They finally ripped. 

Half my position was capped by covered calls I sold while waiting. 

Watched six figures of upside slip away (again).

#3. LEAPs (360+ days)

Quality stocks at a discount. Buy slowly. 

Boring for months, then one week pays more than everything else combined.

#4. Selling puts

The paycheck that keeps you patient while your LEAPs cook. 

Enter on red days, collect premium, repeat.

The best system I've ever used fits on a napkin: 

Sell puts on dips, then buy LEAPs with house money.
